data.name: The Fading Memory
data.detailed_description:
The Fading Memory is a first-person psychological horror game inspired by Indonesian folklore and the terrifying legend of Wewe Gombel — a supernatural entity known for kidnapping children during the night.

You play as Bima, a young man determined to rescue his best friend, Dimas, who mysteriously disappeared after encountering a strange presence near the forest.

Driven by fear and desperation, Bima ventures deep into the cursed woods in search of his friend.

But something else is waiting there.

As the forest grows darker, reality begins to distort.
Whispers echo between the trees.
Shadowy figures move in the distance.
And the deeper you go… the harder it becomes to escape.

Explore the Cursed Forest

Navigate through dark forests, abandoned places, and hidden paths while searching for clues about Dimas’ disappearance.

Every area hides secrets.
Every sound could mean danger.

Survive the Horror

Face terrifying supernatural events inspired by Indonesian mythology.

Experience:

  • Atmospheric first-person horror

  • Intense and unpredictable jumpscares

  • Puzzle-solving and exploration

  • Psychological tension and supernatural encounters

  • Immersive environmental storytelling

  • Creepy sound design and dark ambience

Uncover the Truth

What really happened to Dimas?
Why did the Wewe Gombel take him?
And what secrets are hidden deep within the forest?

Some places should never be entered alone.

Features

  • Indonesian folklore-inspired horror experience

  • First-person exploration gameplay

  • Psychological and supernatural horror

  • Dark atmospheric environments

  • Puzzles and environmental challenges

  • Dynamic horror events and jumpscares

  • Story-driven adventure

Content Warning

This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, disturbing imagery, and intense psychological horror elements that may not be suitable for all players.

data.short_description: Enter a cursed forest to rescue your missing friend who was taken by the legendary Wewe Gombel. Survive terrifying supernatural encounters, solve puzzles, and uncover the dark secrets hidden within the woods.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or equivalent with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
